card.name: The warning against chewing tablets
card.fires_on: The word "chew" in tablet or capsule instructions telling patients to swallow whole and not crush, split, or chew. It sits in a list with crush, divide, or dissolve.

modes.label: The word after "do not"
modes.description: "chew" directly follows "do not" in a swallow-whole warning.
modes.example: Swallow esomeprazole magnesium delayed-release capsules whole; do not<< chew>> or crush the capsules.

modes.label: The word in a list of actions
modes.description: "chew" appears in a list after crush or divide.
modes.example: Administer tablets whole; do not divide, crush,<< chew>>, or dissolve Dalfampridine
